needs_human.note: A drive whose path lies under /app/data would make ./data a drive source. With --with-drives, the main data/ would then be cloned a second time, without a live-DB snapshot, into .r5-stack/drives/N-data. That clone goes unused because the data branch in plan_overlay takes precedence, so it only costs time and space.; With nested backend binds (a parent and a child that both hold drives), --with-drives clones the child separately as well. That clone is never mounted, because the child bind is redirected into the parent's clone.
